steps.title: Transfer MasterMix to qPCR wells
steps.instruction: Using the P300 single‑channel pipette, aspirate 48 µL of MasterMix from the 2.0 mL tube in slot 1 and dispense it into columns 1, 4, 7 and 10 of the final qPCR plate (or strip tubes) in slot 4. Because the MasterMix is viscous, use an air gap, touch‑tip after aspiration, a blow‑out at the end of each dispense, include a short delay after aspiration, and set the pipette flow rate to a reduced value.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 48 µL MasterMix from tube (slot 1) with air gap.
Dispense 48 µL into column 1 of plate (slot 4); blow out, touch tip, delay.
Dispense 48 µL into column 4 of plate (slot 4); blow out, touch tip, delay.
Dispense 48 µL into column 7 of plate (slot 4); blow out, touch tip, delay.
Dispense 48 µL into column 10 of plate (slot 4); blow out, touch tip, delay.

steps.title: Add DNA samples to qPCR plate
steps.instruction: Using the P20 multi‑channel pipette, transfer 12 µL of DNA from the strip tubes in slot 7 to the corresponding columns of the final qPCR plate in slot 4: column 1 of DNA to column 1 of plate, column 2 of DNA to column 4 of plate, and column 3 of DNA to column 7 of plate. Apply viscous‑handling settings (air gap, touch tip, blow out, post‑aspiration delay, reduced flow rate).

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 12 µL DNA from column 1 of strip tubes (slot 7) with air gap.
Dispense into column 1 of final plate (slot 4); blow out, touch tip, delay.
Aspirate 12 µL DNA from column 2 of strip tubes (slot 7) with air gap.
Dispense into column 4 of final plate (slot 4); blow out, touch tip, delay.
Aspirate 12 µL DNA from column 3 of strip tubes (slot 7) with air gap.
Dispense into column 7 of final plate (slot 4); blow out, touch tip, delay.

steps.title: Add control DNA to qPCR plate
steps.instruction: Using the P20 multi‑channel pipette, transfer 12 µL of control DNA from the strip tube in slot 9 (column 12) to column 10 of the final qPCR plate in slot 4. Keep this strip tube separate to avoid contamination. Use the same viscous‑handling parameters as above.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 12 µL control DNA from column 12 of strip tubes (slot 9) with air gap.
Dispense into column 10 of final plate (slot 4); blow out, touch tip, delay.

steps.title: Mix and distribute qPCR reactions
steps.instruction: For each MasterMix/DNA column (1, 4, 7, 10) in the final plate, mix the contents 5 times using a 20 µL volume with the P20 multi‑channel pipette, then transfer 20 µL from that column to the two subsequent columns (e.g., from column 1 to columns 2 and 3). Ensure complete expulsion of viscous solution with air gaps, blow outs, and post‑aspiration delays.

substeps.instruction: Mix column 1: aspirate and dispense 20 µL five times; blow out.
Transfer 20 µL from column 1 to column 2; blow out, touch tip, delay.
Transfer 20 µL from column 1 to column 3; blow out, touch tip, delay.
Mix column 4: aspirate and dispense 20 µL five times; blow out.
Transfer 20 µL from column 4 to column 5; blow out, touch tip, delay.
Transfer 20 µL from column 4 to column 6; blow out, touch tip, delay.
Mix column 7: aspirate and dispense 20 µL five times; blow out.
Transfer 20 µL from column 7 to column 8; blow out, touch tip, delay.
Transfer 20 µL from column 7 to column 9; blow out, touch tip, delay.
Mix column 10: aspirate and dispense 20 µL five times; blow out.
Transfer 20 µL from column 10 to column 11; blow out, touch tip, delay.
Transfer 20 µL from column 10 to column 12; blow out, touch tip, delay.
